A check of the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)): not a journey with steps a person takes, but a script that opens pages and reports what is wrong (Faro’s `evals/notes/2-goal-page.cjs`). ## What it checks

Lane's review notes (5 Nov), goal-page, as rebuilt into the flagship page the same day. run({ open, url, browser }) returns a list of failures. What each old check protected, and where it is now: - the four facts (against plan, trend, since, projection) → the summary bar's scorecard (vs plan, vs last week, to target, will it hit), marked on the chart (the scorecard, 5 Nov); the facts themselves are still worked out once in summaryFacts and scorecard (evals/goalSummary.eval.ts, src/domain/scorecard.test.ts); - the reason and whether it's being handled → the top of Why, under the chart; - the path to green in the main column → Why, in the main column, with the owner's date labelled (GT1); - the grouped side column → Next steps and asks and Last time we talked, under labelled headings (GT1); - the header that stays on screen → the summary bar itself shrinking to one line, under the review bar when there is one; - what it feeds and how it's measured under the title → About this goal (open on a first visit), and Back naming the goal it feeds when you arrive from outside; - the review walk (chart and check-ins open, each check-in opening in full, full width when stacked) → unchanged; - check-ins opening in full on the Check-ins tab → the same rows in the Activity stream; - goal rows that never draw over each other → the rows in What feeds it.
